description: Wait for multiple AI agent processes to complete and return their results. Defaults to compact result items; set verbose to true for full metadata and detailed parsed output.

pids.description: List of process IDs to wait for (returned by the run tool).

timeout.description: Optional: Maximum time to wait in seconds. Defaults to 180 (3 minutes). Set to 0 to wait without a timeout.

verbose.description: Optional: If true, each result item uses the full result shape including metadata fields and detailed parsed output. Defaults to false.

name: wait
